status: POST HOC follow-up to the frozen final-filter single-constant study. Written after its test results were seen; nothing here changes the frozen results, choices or verdicts.

part_1_timing.requested_hardware: Apple M2 (the hardware on which the 10.74 ms limit was set)
part_1_timing.limit: absolute p90 <= 10.74 ms: the ORIGINAL pre-registered limit. The 1.02 x arm-A ratio used in the main study was only the fallback for the cloud machine, where arm A itself exceeded the cap.
part_1_timing.method: One process, one CPU thread, float64. For every world and fit the arms run back to back on the same inputs, with the arm order rotated per call (A,C2,C3 / C2,C3,A / C3,A,C2) so no arm always runs first. Warm-up on two worlds before timing. Nothing else running.
part_1_timing.worlds: 153 grid settings x 3 indices = 459 worlds; indices 900, 901, 902 in the main study's timing seed domain (2026103106), disjoint from windows 1 (700-702) and 2 (800-802)

scopes.snr_30_60: SNR 30-60 dB, all RSR (the scope named '30-60 dB target range' in the follow-up request)
scopes.rsr5_above_30: RSR 5 dB, SNR > 30 dB (the 'target range' defined in the main pre-registration, existing 'weak_target')

part_1_timing.report: p90, max per arm and scope; C2/A and C3/A p90 ratios; pass/fail of each arm against 10.74 ms in full_grid AND snr_30_60, and separately in rsr5_above_30
part_1_timing.cloud_diagnostic: The same script is also run on the cloud x86 machine and reported ONLY as a labelled diagnostic (ratios); it is not an M2 result and gives no pass/fail against the absolute limit.

part_2_c3.arm: C3 = C2 (noise scale, c = 4, beta = 1, nominal SNR > 30 dB) but applied only where the receiver's routed EM-tail length is > 0 (proposal_policy.tails after the family-mismatch rule). Recovery decisions stay those of the frozen receiver, as in the main study.
part_2_c3.where_c3_filters: reference key 5: SNR key >= 40 dB; reference keys 12/20: SNR key >= 32.5 dB; never at 31.25 dB (zero-tail mismatch). See ../POLICY_TRACE.md.
part_2_c3.settings: 153 grid cells + off-grid SNR {31.25, 33.75, 36.25, 38.75, 47.5} dB x grid RSR (45) + RSR {0, 8, 16} dB x 22 SNRs (198) = 396 cells, 3 path regimes, 128 channels per cell, 3 fits
part_2_c3.metrics: same as the main study: cell NMSE (dB of ratio of sums, mean over fits), mean-setting and pooled NMSE, BER through the existing detector (64 vectors per channel), 20,000-draw block bootstrap within (regime, reference), shared across SNR/arm/fit

questions.Q1: Does C3 remove the > 1 dB losses at 31.25 dB (C2 - A > 1 dB at RSR 12/16 in the main test)? Pass if no 31.25 dB cell has C3 - A > 1 dB.
questions.Q2: Does C3 keep C2's gains elsewhere? Report C3 - C2 per scope with intervals, and list every cell where C3 is worse than C2 by > 0.3 dB.
questions.limits: The main study's L1-L3 are also reported for C3 against A, descriptively (post hoc).
